verdict.rationale: Zero's only programmatic surface is its own MCP server. MCP.md lists tools an agent can call to drive the mailbox: get threads, list folders, create, send and delete emails, manage labels, and search. That makes it a direct but thin capability. An independent check found no public HTTP API, no endpoint schema and no docs site, and authentication means copying a browser session cookie, with OAuth listed as coming soon. Missing for 10: a documented public HTTP/REST API with endpoint schemas and reference docs, proper API auth (OAuth or API keys rather than a copied session cookie), and independent hands-on corroboration of programmatic use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Get email threads by ID - List emails in specific folders - Create and send new emails - Create email drafts - Send existing drafts - Delete emails
Get all user labels - Create new custom labels with custom colors - Delete existing labels
You can connecto ZeroMCP using two methods: 1. Better Auth session token 2. OAuth (Coming soon)
"Zero MCP provides the following capabilities": get threads, list folders, create and send emails
